PC: Perform focused history and physical exam
Serial assessment of patient and repeat ECG when chest pain returns
When chest pain returns, the patient should receive SL Nitroglycerin.
MK: Order STAT ECG and interpret appropriately i. Recognize acute change in ECG #1 (Wellens’ or TW inversions in anterior leads) in comparison to old ECG ii. Recognize need for repeat ECG in patients with changes in condition iii. Recognize STEMI in ECG #2
SBP: Activate Cath Lab and start appropriate anticoagulation
Don't stress test a patient with Wellens'!
